description: Enhanced handler-failure coverage: a per-batch handler that throws a readable reason reflects the failure on the batch action line and span status; a per-batch handler that throws a value with no readable reason maps to the empty-message category; and a two-step per-message scenario shows a successful delivery followed by a failed one in the same run.
